label: Excerpt from
description: Source is a highlight, quote or clip taken from the target. Each excerpt is taken from one item; an item can have many excerpts. An excerpt with no title of its own is named after the target, such as "Excerpt from Thinking, Fast and Slow". The excerpt carries its own text, stays in lists and stays when its source is binned or purged (orphan). Use it for a passage taken from an item, `about` for a topical link and `references` for a mention in text.
